- Pricing / capacity review: 30 minutes — go over your usage forecast (tokens/day), peak concurrency, and whether Dedicated capacity sizing makes sense

Possible slots (PT): Tue 5/27 3pm-4:30pm, Wed 5/28 9am-10:30am, Thu 5/28 11am-12:30pm. Happy to flex.
